title: Booking a bike for somebody else
_dead_note: The capture opens and closes on the macOS wallpaper, with white flash frames between it and the app. Scene 1 starts at 2.37s and the last scene ends at 70.8s, so no junk is inside any segment. The MASTER is untouched.
_frames_note: `frames` on each scene is its own footage at 30fps — the rate was MEASURED, never assumed 25.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Booking a bike for somebody else. Enter your email for a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty. You are booking for somebody else this time.

scenes.label: party-members
scenes.line: Invite a party member to the order.

scenes.label: member-added
scenes.line: They are on the order now.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection and choose their bike. Ladies, mens, boys, girls and electric each have their own.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day they collect it, then the day it comes back.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now their age and their height, so we set the frame and the saddle before they arrive. Then agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the booking.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: The order is complete, and their bike is booked and waiting.
